fullAgreementText:
APNAZO SUPER APP MERCHANT & PARTNER AGREEMENT

1. SCOPE AND ELIGIBILITY
This Partner Agreement governs the onboarding and commercial operations of merchants, drivers, and service professionals on the Apnazo Super App operating in Rourkela, Odisha. By completing OTP e-sign, the Partner agrees to fulfill customer orders with high quality and honest pricing.

2. COMMISSIONS & PAYOUTS
- Commission rates are capped as specified in your category schedule (5% to 10%).
- All net earnings after platform commission and applicable statutory deductions (TDS/TCS) are credited on a T+2 business day rolling schedule directly to the verified bank account.

3. CANCELLATION & DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Orders cancelled by the seller without valid inventory justification may be subject to review. Disputes are handled via Apnazo Partner Helpdesk within 24 hours.

4. COMPLIANCE & SAFETY
Partners in food/grocery must maintain valid FSSAI licences. Drivers must maintain valid commercial licences and insurance as per Motor Vehicles Act.
